run_convert_voc_to_mmdet: run the CLI to convert PASCAL VOC annotations to mmdetection pkl format
run_convert_voc_to_coco: run the CLI to convert PASCAL VOC annotations to COCO json format
parse_xml_annotation: parse a PASCAL VOC xml annotation file into bboxes and labels arrays
cvt_annotations_to_pkl: convert VOC annotations for a given year and split into a pkl file
cvt_to_coco_json: convert mmdetection-style annotations list into a COCO json dict structure
